_meanings: Belonging to or descended from Bharata.

.²1 A descendant of Bharata; (such as {#vidura#}; {#saYjAtaharzo munimAha BArataH#}
 <ls>Mb. 3. 20. 8</ls>; also {#DftarAzwra, arjuna#} in <ls>Bg.</ls>).
.²2 An inhabitant of {%Bharatavarṣa%} or India.
.²3 An actor.
.²4 An epithet of the sun shining on the south of Meru.
.²5 Fire.
